relative_strength_rank.limitation: momentum.json carries no relative-strength rank per alert, so no rank is fabricated. The page shows System state (Open position, with stop / trail / targets / unrealized) instead, per the plan's 'rank OR system state' wording.

replay_frame: Learning-loop replay trades: signals at close, entry at next open, frame +4xATR target / -2xATR stop / 20-session timeout, same-session double touch = loss, full NEPSE costs. Success = target hit before stop within 20 sessions. This is NOT the backtest PF frame.
replay_note: Momentum.json trade_counts.closed_in_ledger is 500, matching the capped replay list. The full backtest closed_total on main is 766 (b1 preparation said 767 on Oct-02 data). The era table covers the capped 500, not all 766.

shadow_f2_t2_supply.rule: Skip a momentum entry taken within 2 sessions after a T+2 supply event (markup/volume-spike day).
shadow_f2_t2_supply.verdict: PASS in the learning loop (OOS improves, no era degradation, n adequate). Shadow only: portfolio simulation is still required before any live stat changes. No filtered PF or CAGR is claimed — only the mean-PnL gain on the kept subset.

sma200_regime.limitation: momentum.json does not carry SMA200 distance per alert, so this page does NOT claim each current alert passes SMA200. Per-alert SMA200 status is future builder work, not invented here.
sma200_regime.rule: Read an open position as trend-aligned only if price is above a rising SMA200. Momentum's own setup already requires close above SMA50 and SMA20 above SMA50.
